The only reason I joined father to travel this far from the capital was to escape its greed and lust and raving thirst for blood. Important work in the empire I suppose, but so… heartless. There is no poetry around here. Money, money, money. Earn it, spend it, sleep, repeat. Everyone lives for money. Except that oddslug who gave it all up. The builder of the Judgment Pit – what’s his name? Right, Kwyn. A poor storyteller of unburied items. Children adore him. source:
Allomother Emya of Living Beings,
Allofather Snahoon of Sun and Rain,
May this prayer rise to meet you
Upon this smoke of burning hair
Cut from my head like stalks of wild rice 
That feed us from the mud.

I do not pray often. I know. But I am reminded of your life-giving gifts as I am pregnant through the touch of my beloved Kwyn. 

Happiness lifts my soul. Worry weighs my mind. 

Kwyn is home to my heart. A peaceful man who lives for sharing knowledge and understanding the mysteries of the past. Though, I have not told father of our love. My father is a strong provider but a narrow thinker who bows to rich Lords in hopes of slaking his desire for status and comfort. Please soften his mind and heart. I know this wasn’t the plan he had for me. 

I ask for protection of my child. I ask for protection from men with hearts as cold as Massushells. 

Allomother, Allofather:
 May this prayer rise to meet you.
 May this prayer rise to meet you.
target:
众生之母艾米雅，
日雨之父斯纳洪，
愿此祈祷升向祢们，
乘着燃发之烟。
发丝自头顶剪落，如野稻茎，
自泥中养育我们。

我知道，我很少祈祷。但挚爱奎恩的触碰，让我怀了孩子，也使我想起祢们赐予生命的恩惠。

幸福托起灵魂，忧虑压着心。

奎恩是我心的归宿。他平和，为分享知识、理解过去的谜团而活。但我尚未告诉父亲我们的爱。父亲善于养家，思想却狭隘，向有钱领主低头，只盼满足对地位与安逸的渴望。请柔软他的心思。我知道，这不是他替我安排的路。

我祈求保护我的孩子，祈求免受那些心如马苏贝币般冰冷的人伤害。

众生之母，日雨之父：
愿此祈祷升向祢们。

source: Leyál: It is all delicious. Thank you, Lord Sharoof, though you need not treat me to dinner every time I visit to sculpt your hair.
target: 蕾雅：都很好吃。谢谢沙鲁夫领主，不过每次替您雕发，您不必都请我吃晚餐。

source: Lord Sharoof: Ah, but there’s good reason to treat a beauty like you. You see, this is your fifth dinner with me, and so I may now ask you –
target: 沙鲁夫领主：啊，款待妳这般美人，当然有好理由。这已是妳第五次与我共进晚餐，所以现在我可以问妳——

source: Leyál: My Lord! Is that a proposal necklace? I – I’m sorry. I cannot accept this. The necklace you hold – pearl and truly beautiful, but I cannot accept it. I am with child and in love with another.

source: Lord Sharoof: BLOOD LAWS state that I may invoke the Blood-for-Blood Mandate. I stake my blood in exchange for the child’s blood upon birth. THUS, Kwyn, as father, is entitled to defend his unborn child against me in the Judgement Pit… if he can.

source: Lord Sharoof: Please, please my beauty – it is not Ladylike to gape your mouth… unless it is to receive me, hah!
